frozen_note: Thresholds, arm definitions and the held-out window rule are frozen before any arm is run on held-out footage. Change only via a new frozen_at entry recorded BEFORE results are seen.
detections: One frozen GPU detect run per window (P1, approval required). Every arm and ablation replays the same detections_raw.

A0.replay_cmd: director_replay --events <window events.jsonl> --worlds tracker --panner-preset v4_micro_damping --active-ball --roi <venue roi json>

A1.replay_cmd: director_replay --events <window events.jsonl> --worlds tracker --panner-preset v4_micro_damping --active-ball --roi <venue roi json> --ball-gate --ownership-roi <venue roi json>

B0.replay_cmd: director_replay --events <window events.jsonl> --worlds tracker --panner-preset v4_micro_damping --active-ball --roi <venue roi json> --ball-weight 0

counterattack_definition: possession change to attacking third within 4 s (9v9 on 7v7-size pitch; tightened from 6 s)

held_out.session: Aylestone Rec, bigger pitch, ~10v10 (Johnson; count to verify)
rules: first-pass results recorded and published before any tuning
after that Aylestone is development data, not independent

footage.limitations: 2 sessions / 2 venues: ranks arms and detects transfer failure; does not accept the MVP. Acceptance needs 4-5 sessions including adjacent matches.

window_freeze.reason: Corrections from Johnson/ChatGPT review: Aylestone is 2611.6 s (43:32) so 40-45 min was invalid; St Margaret's 10-15 min overlapped sample_02 (769.33-949.33 s). Replaces the earlier 3x5-min-at-10/25/40 rule and the older 8-window draft.
window_freeze.times_are: seconds into the LEFT source file; both sides are cut at the same start (as the existing sample sets); inter-camera sync is solved by reco calibrate
window_freeze.camera_side_note: Aylestone: GX010175 is the LEFT camera (fence at its far left, view runs into the pitch), GX010198 the RIGHT (fence at its far right; its partner GoPro is visible on that fence). Opposite file pairing to St Margaret's (left GX010197). Calibrate is the final check.

frozen_params_first_pass.player_tracker: PlayerTrackerConfig::oev_default (own 1.5 s, disown 5 s, gate 0.015-0.08 rad, confirm 3, max_missed 1 s)
frozen_params_first_pass.ball_gate: player 0.35 rad, last tracked ball 0.30 rad
frozen_params_first_pass.hybrid: HybridConfig::oev006 (neighbourhood 0.30 rad, missing 2.0 s, decay 0.97, dwell 0.5 s, stoppage 0.02 rad/s for 1.5 s)
frozen_params_first_pass.rule: May be tuned on St Margaret's development windows only; values in force when the held-out first pass runs are recorded with its results.
